visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with wavy black hair wearing a striped shirt stands in front of a green chalkboard. He uses his arm as a compass to draw a perfect circle with white chalk. He then grabs a silver baseball bat, posing confidently. The room has bright indoor lighting and a clock on the wall. (2) He draws a right-angled triangle on the board, labeling the angles as ninety and forty-five degrees. He points to these numbers using the tip of the baseball bat. His facial expressions are animated, mimicking an intense teacher. Various books sit on the wooden podium in the foreground. (3) He writes several large Chinese characters representing chemical elements on the chalkboard. He writes "Hydrogen", "Lithium", "Sodium", and "Potassium" while speaking loudly. He points at each character with the bat, his body movements are sharp and rhythmic, showing high physical energy. (4) The man suddenly recoils from the board with a shocked and frustrated facial expression, clutching his hand or gesturing wildly. He appears to be reacting to a mistake or a funny realization. The camera remains static at eye-level, capturing his theatrical reaction and messy writing. (5) He continues the lesson, pointing the baseball bat at the board to explain a mnemonic device involving the "Gold" radical in Chinese characters. He looks directly at the camera with a smirk at the end. The visual rhythm is fast due to frequent jump cuts between these instructional moments.
